description: Test prompts that verify rdk-model-zoo triggers and produces correct, branch-aware guidance for running ready-made BPU models. Prompts are written the way a real RDK developer would phrase them (Chinese). Run with-skill vs baseline and grade the assertions.

evals.name: s600-branch-and-artifact
evals.prompt: 我板子是 RDK S600，Model Zoo 有现成的 YOLO11 吗？该用哪个分支、什么格式？
evals.expected_output: Yes — clone the rdk_s branch of rdk_model_zoo (current S100/S100P/S600 branch), artifact .hbm, runtime hbm_runtime. Notes appendix has LLM-only benchmark for S600.

assertions.text: Says to use the rdk_s branch of rdk_model_zoo (not a feat/* dev branch, not rdk_model_zoo_s).
States the S600 artifact is .hbm and the runtime is hbm_runtime.
Mentions YOLO11 is available as an S600 sample (and optionally that the S600 appendix only has an LLM benchmark so far).

evals.name: wrong-branch-pitfall
evals.prompt: RDK Model Zoo 我直接 git clone 下来在 X5 上跑，怎么模型对不上？
evals.expected_output: Branch = board: default clone gets the wrong branch; must clone -b rdk_x5; artifact .bin, runtime hbm_runtime on rdk_x5.

assertions.text: Explains the Model Zoo is split by hardware branch and the user likely cloned the wrong branch.
Says to clone with -b rdk_x5 for an X5 board.
Does NOT tell the user to quantize their own model — the fix is selecting the right branch/precompiled artifact.

evals.name: run-sample-entrypoint
evals.prompt: Model Zoo 的检测示例我下下来了，runtime/python 里好几个 .py，到底跑哪个？
evals.expected_output: Run main.py with --task/--model-path, not python3 *.py; the other .py are per-task helpers.

assertions.text: Says to run main.py (the entry point), not python3 *.py or one of the per-task scripts directly.

evals.name: cross-arch-not-portable
evals.prompt: 我在 X5 上转好的 .bin，能直接拷到 S100 上用 Model Zoo 的脚本跑吗？
evals.expected_output: No — X5 .bin (Bayes-e) vs S100 .hbm (Nash) are not interchangeable; pull the S-series precompiled model from rdk_s or rebuild.

assertions.text: Says no — a .bin cannot run on S100.
Explains cross-architecture incompatibility (X5 Bayes-e .bin vs S100 Nash .hbm).
Says to get the S-series .hbm from the rdk_s branch (or rebuild via the toolchain).

evals.name: x5-quant-accuracy-drop
evals.prompt: X5 上 yolo11n 量化以后掉多少精度，帧率大概多少？
evals.expected_output: Points to the X5 detection appendix giving Float/PyTorch AP vs Python on-board AP; yolo11n ~122 FPS, AP ~0.323 -> ~0.308.

assertions.text: Points to the X5 detection benchmark that reports PyTorch AP vs Python (on-board, post-quant) AP.
Gives a concrete yolo11n figure (e.g. ~122 FPS, AP ~0.32 PyTorch -> ~0.31 on-board) or directs to per-board-model-catalog for it.
